          MYFOODCARD

          A small card.
          A clearer conversation.

          1. Make it yours. Choose your requirements and allergies. Edits save automatically in this browser.
          2. Choose the language. Select one yourself or request a location-based suggestion. Your coordinates aren’t sent to our servers.
          3. Show your card. Open the presentation view for the restaurant, scan the QR code, or use Copy link. Use Copy text for a short summary to paste into forms.

          Wait for “Ready offline” before travelling. You can add this app to your home screen from your browser. Offline access needs an initial online visit and depends on your browser retaining saved data. Export a backup before clearing browser data.

          Eight card languages: English, Slovak, Czech, German, French, Spanish, Arabic and Thai. Profile controls are in English. Location suggestions are approximate; you always choose the final language.

          Location boundaries: Natural Earth (public domain). Translations are drafts awaiting professional review.
